pois.name: Knight's Encampment
pois.summary: Early Crystal Monument — save and rest point near the starting knight camp.
pois.howToFind: From the beach landing, face west and smash the wooden barricade (many hits). The monument sits just beyond it at the knight camp fork.
pois.tips: Resting fully heals you but respawns nearby enemies. Saving does not respawn enemies. Save often — there are no auto-checkpoints.

pois.name: Cemetery Precipice
pois.summary: Cliffside Crystal Monument overlooking the island cemetery paths.
pois.howToFind: From the knight camp area, climb northeast up the hill. Look for a blue glow along the precipice — that is the Cemetery Precipice monument.
pois.tips: Useful hub before the mausoleum routes and Wind Crystal side paths. Save before risky dashes and lizard fights nearby.

pois.name: Deimpo Mausoleum (front)
pois.summary: Locked mausoleum landmark east of Cemetery Precipice; key story item route.
pois.howToFind: From Cemetery Precipice, head east past tombstones and Star Lizard ground. The locked mausoleum front sits on that raised cemetery road.
pois.tips: Clear lizards carefully before engaging near the door. Notes nearby mention a book delivered here by mainland knights.

pois.name: Endu Shrine
pois.summary: Fenced shrine holding the Shrine Guardian fight and the Holy Sword Endu path.
pois.howToFind: Near the starting coast / dagger-belt beach islands. Look for a small gated compound; the Endu Shrine Gate Key opens it. Boss waits inside.
pois.tips: Prepare before entering — the fight starts once you go in. A longer-reach weapon helps keep distance from the overhead slam.

pois.name: Wing Altar (Isle of Neasied)
pois.summary: Isle of Neasied Wing Altar — unlocks fast travel to other altars you have found.
pois.howToFind: Search the island after major paths open; each zone typically hides one Wing Altar. Look for the altar structure once you are past the early barricade and shrine routes.
pois.tips: A Wing Stone Fragment can warp you to a discovered altar from elsewhere (consumable). Save it for emergencies, not routine travel.

pois.name: Cave Entrance Obmuer Temple
pois.summary: Crystal Monument just inside the Obmuer Temple cave entrance door.
pois.howToFind: From Aganmi's Camp outside Obmuer Temple, clear the approach, open the cave door, and the monument is immediately inside the entrance.
pois.tips: Rest and save before diving into slate / trident-key puzzles deeper in the temple.

pois.name: Sacred Cistern
pois.summary: Mid-temple Crystal Monument at the Sacred Cistern chamber.
pois.howToFind: Progress through Obmuer Temple key doors (trident keys). After raising the staircase and unlocking the cistern door, save at Sacred Cistern Obmuer Temple.
pois.tips: Later Wind Dash upgrades let you cross the cistern gap. Side levers open return paths to the entrance and cistern.

pois.name: Prison Corridor Obmuer Temple
pois.summary: Crystal Monument in the daylight-lit prison corridor wing.
pois.howToFind: From Sacred Cistern routes, clear ahead and move into the east hallway lit by daylight. The Prison Corridor monument is there.
pois.tips: Save before later temple bosses and slate collection loops.

pois.name: Wing Altar (Obmuer Temple)
pois.summary: Obmuer Temple Wing Altar for fast travel between discovered altars.
pois.howToFind: Search around Aganmi's Camp and the temple approach as you open Obmuer routes. Unlock it before long slate or key loops so you can hop back later.
pois.tips: Counts toward Well Travelled together with Crystal Monuments. Pair it with Cave Entrance / Sacred Cistern saves so you rarely run the full temple cold.
